scope: 36 sampled frames in temporal order, across coast and fleet on phone and fallback.
verdict: The sampled change is a HUD regression in both tiers. The cyan ring helps locate the player over empty water but competes with the aircraft over decks and runway markings, and the Hawk label collisions return.
changes: Player brackets are replaced by a cyan ring that follows the player, with visibly more overlay near the runway circle and the bow.
Hawk grazes the return banner at coast 180 and the minimap at fleet 120 in both tiers.
remaining: The white damage silhouette still interrupts airframe detail at 006 and 012.
The offset dark or blue shapes remain visible over water.
No clear material improvement is discernible at this sampled play scale.

coast-fallback-000.png.evidence: Cyan ring stays centered over the player on the runway and adds a slight blue tint to the surface.

coast-fallback-006.png.evidence: Player turns solid white with hull loss and Return to Base. The cyan circle sits near the separate runway circle.

coast-fallback-012.png.evidence: White silhouette remains visible. Two circles and a separate cyan Hawk label compete with the tracers.

coast-fallback-024.png.evidence: Aircraft material returns. Ring crosses the runway threshold markings and adds a sense of a separate zone.

coast-fallback-036.png.evidence: Bank reduces visible wing area. The larger cyan circle tracks the aircraft, with the smaller runway circle lower in the view.

coast-fallback-060.png.evidence: An orange blast stands out beyond the circle. The tinted ring crosses the edge of the sea and light beach.

coast-fallback-090.png.evidence: Ring keeps the low-contrast player easy to locate as the orange blast falls off to flecks. Thin dark trailing smoke is visible.

coast-fallback-120.png.evidence: Cyan ring stays with the player over water. It reads brighter and larger than the aircraft itself at this scale.

coast-fallback-180.png.evidence: Hawk label grazes the top of Return to Base again. The same sampled frame previously hid the label to keep the mission banner clear.
